data.body:
[P2] Acknowledge successful input delivery before resetting deduplication

The checked-in runner still clears `UpdatedOperationIds` in `_begin_invocation` without advancing `handler_seen_seq` after a valid response. If completed child C owns callback B while the root waits on A, completing B now exports its terminal span during a checkpoint-free PENDING resume that skips C. After A completes, the next checkpoint returns B again; the new invocation has forgotten B and both OTel views export it a second time. Pair eager delivery with acknowledgment of the captured input sequence after successful response validation, preserving newer updates, and add a three-invocation local-runner regression.
